item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 2-1 Doncaster U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s added another three points to their Youth Alliance League tally on Saturday, as they secured a 2-1 victory over Doncaster Rovers at RH Academy. Winger Jayden Chambers-Morgan handed the young Stags the lead in the 25th minute before midfielder Josh Walters doubled their advantage. item.title: Preview: Blackpool v Stags
item.description: Stags face Blackpool tomorrow night at Bloomfield Road (8pm kick-off). Here's all you need to know... TEAM NEWS George Abbott is unlikely to feature tomorrow night due to a thigh injury. Baily Cargill (hamstring) is expected to miss the remainder of the season. Ryan Sweeney (hamstring) will also be out of action for an extended period of time. Tyler Roberts, George Maris and Jordan Bowery are all unable to feature at Bloomfield Road due to injury. item.title: Stags to face Arsenal in Emirates FA Cup fifth round
item.description: Mansfield Town have been drawn at home to Premier League leaders Arsenal in the Emirates FA Cup fifth round. Stags only ever meeting with Arsenal came in the FA Cup in January 1929 at Highbury. The match will take place on the weekend of Saturday 07 March. Ticket information will be announced in due course.
